description: Compares 2 to 8 different devices side by side, one row per device and screen: window size, pixels, pixels per unit, safe-area insets, the safe area's rectangle and corner radii. Uses each device's current runtime and its reading at rotation 0 unless an orientation or runtime is named. At rotation 0 a foldable's open screen can be landscape, as the Pixel Fold's open and half-open screens are; name an orientation to compare like with like.

items.description: A device id from list_devices, such as iphone-17 or pixel-8.

runtime.description: A runtime build such as 24A434, or a version such as 27.2 or 16, written exactly as list_devices gives it (27.0, not 27). A version names the device's current build when it is the current version, else that version's newest release build. The device's current build when omitted.

name: compare_devices

corners.description: Corner radii for the reading's orientation, with where they come from.

rect.description: A frame in the reading's window coordinates: origin at the window's top left, in the device's unit.

prerelease.description: A pre-release build; never a device's `current`.

missing.description: Devices or screens with no reading for the runtime or orientation asked, and why.

pixelsPerUnit.description: Physical pixels per pt or dp: the scale on iOS, the density divided by 160 on Android, unrounded.

screen.description: A foldable's pose: closed, open, half-open or tent; every other device has main only.

title: Compare devices
